overview: SWIREASONING is a training-free inference framework for reasoning LLMs that dynamically alternates between explicit chain-of-thought and latent thinking based on block-wise entropy-trend confidence signals, and suppresses overthinking via a switch count controller to improve both accuracy and token efficiency.

modules.name: Explicit Thinking Decoder
modules.description: Implements standard chain-of-thought decoding where the model commits to a single discrete token at each step via a hard policy (greedy argmax or top-k/top-p sampling), producing readable intermediate reasoning steps.

modules.name: Latent Thinking Module
modules.description: Implements training-free latent reasoning by computing a probability-weighted mixture of token embeddings (soft embedding) from the next-token distribution, which is fed back as the input representation instead of committing to a discrete token, preserving distributional information and multiple implicit hypotheses.

modules.name: Entropy Estimator
modules.description: Computes the Shannon entropy of the next-token distribution at each decoding step, serving as the confidence signal. Tracks a reference entropy per thinking block, initialized at block start and refreshed upon mode switches.

modules.name: Dynamic Mode Switch Controller
modules.description: Implements the entropy-trend-based switching criterion: Latent→Explicit when entropy drops below the reference (confidence rises) for immediate consolidation, and Explicit→Latent when entropy exceeds the reference (confidence drops) to re-explore in continuous space. Manages mode variable and reference entropy updates across the decoding trajectory.

modules.name: Asymmetric Dwell Window Enforcer
modules.description: Enforces dwell windows on mode transitions to prevent oscillations: Latent→Explicit switches may occur immediately (zero dwell), while Explicit→Latent switches require staying for at least a minimum number of steps. Resets dwell counters upon switching and increments them otherwise.

modules.name: Thinking-Related Signal Mixer
modules.description: Blends thinking-related special token embeddings (⟨think⟩ and ⟨/think⟩) at mode transition boundaries. At latent block entrance, biases the first soft embedding toward the begin-thinking signal; at explicit block exit, biases toward the end-thinking signal, with scheduled mixing ratios that evolve over generation steps.

modules.name: Switch Count Controller
modules.description: Caps the total number of Latent→Explicit switches to suppress overthinking. Implements a convergence trigger that injects ⟨/think⟩ when the switch count reaches half the budget, encouraging early answer generation from partial reasoning, and a termination trigger that forcibly injects an answer prefix and enforces a hard token limit when the switch count exceeds the budget.

modules.name: Token Injection Queue
modules.description: Manages a per-sample deterministic token injection queue that overwrites model-generated tokens when convergence or termination triggers fire. Handles queue population, sequential popping of injected tokens, and budget counter decrementing for termination-triggered answer generation.

modules.name: SWIREASONING Unified Decoding Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates the full decoding loop by integrating explicit/latent thinking, entropy estimation, dynamic mode switching, dwell windows, signal mixing, switch count control, and token injection into a single coherent inference algorithm, managing the shared state (mode, counters, queues, reference entropy) across all steps.

modules.name: Token Budget Manager
modules.description: Manages both unlimited and limited token budget scenarios for evaluation. Controls maximum generation length per benchmark, tracks token consumption, and coordinates with the switch count controller to enable early answering under constrained budgets.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implements all paper evaluation metrics: Pass@1 accuracy, Pass@k accuracy (with k varying from 1 to 64), plain token efficiency (accuracy per token), normalized token efficiency relative to standard CoT, and average efficiency gain via area-under-curve integration over token budgets.

modules.name: Benchmark Runner and Baseline Orchestrator
modules.description: Coordinates evaluation across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, STEM, coding, and general reasoning domains. Runs SWIREASONING alongside three baselines (CoT with sampling, CoT with greedy decoding, Soft Thinking) under comparable settings, managing model loading, prompt formatting, answer extraction, and repeated trial execution.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Supports systematic ablation studies covering: switch window size sweeps, entrance/exit signal mixing ratio sweeps (α₀ and β₀), maximum switch count variations, convergence trigger positioning relative to termination, latent mode isolation under small budgets, and symmetric vs. asymmetric window comparisons.

modules.name: Result Aggregation and Visualization Module
modules.description: Aggregates raw evaluation outputs into structured tables (accuracy comparisons across models/benchmarks, efficiency gains), generates Pareto frontier plots of accuracy vs. token budget, Pass@k curves, entropy/similarity distribution visualizations, switch count box plots, and latency/TFLOPs efficiency charts.
